changelog: Makes the Observatory easy to reach. It is now answered at the short address /orca - so on a typical setup, http://your-server:8096/orca rather than the full route - and there are two ways to it from inside Jellyfin that do not involve remembering any address at all: an Orca Observatory entry in the Jellyfin sidebar, and an Open Orca Observatory button on the plugin's own settings page under Dashboard - Plugins - Orca Engine, which also prints the direct link for bookmarking. The sidebar entry is only a redirect to the dashboard, not the dashboard itself: it renders its link as ordinary markup and merely enhances it with an automatic redirect, so it still works if its script does not run. The dashboard continues to run as its own standalone page. No engine behaviour, configuration or database changes.
